scope: Private input cursor dependency cut, combined with final-only result authorization. Functional and structural qualification does not establish receiver timing or hardware operation.

implementation.change: Retire the private position cursor on a presented, ready input while the slot is open, saturating at position 511, independently of checked-beat certification. A malformed or duplicate beat can advance this private cursor only on the same edge that unchanged fault logic quarantines the slot. Public checks use the original pre-edge position; no subsequent delivery or certificate is permitted before reset.
implementation.preserved: All public checker outputs, core validity/data/last, framing/identity checks, certificates, completion, immediate faults, sticky reasons and common-reset behavior. No arithmetic, coefficients, ABI, clocks or constraints changed.
